modules.name: openblas
build-commands: make PREFIX=/app TARGET=GENERIC DYNAMIC_ARCH=1 NUM_THREADS=64 USE_OPENMP=0 install

modules.name: lighttable-source
build-commands: CARGO_HOME=$PWD/cargo CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$PWD/target/resident cargo build --offline --locked --release --manifest-path application/rust-engine/Cargo.toml --bin lighttable-engine
CARGO_HOME=$PWD/cargo CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$PWD/target/desktop cargo build --offline --locked --release --manifest-path application/windows-shell/Cargo.toml --bin lighttable-desktop-shell
CARGO_HOME=$PWD/cargo CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$PWD/target/cli cargo build --offline --locked --release --manifest-path rust-cli/Cargo.toml --bin spektrafilm -p spektrafilm-cli
